import numpy as np, mujoco, rcb_dtb
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot
from PIL import Image
class Controller:
 def __init__(self,s):
  self.s=s;self.m=s.model;self.d=s.data;self.kd=mujoco.MjData(self.m);self.b=self.m.body('palmleft_hand_C_MC').id
 def pose(self):return self.d.xpos[self.b].copy(),self.d.xmat[self.b].reshape(3,3).copy()
 def ik(self,p,R,q=None):
  s=self.s;d=self.kd;m=self.m
  if q is None:q=s.targets.copy()
  q=q.copy();jp=np.zeros((3,m.nv));jr=jp.copy()
  for it in range(80):
   d.qpos[:]=self.d.qpos;d.qpos[s._jq]=q;mujoco.mj_forward(m,d)
   e=np.r_[p-d.xpos[self.b],Rot.from_matrix(R@d.xmat[self.b].reshape(3,3).T).as_rotvec()]
   if np.linalg.norm(e)<1e-5:break
   mujoco.mj_jacBody(m,d,jp,jr,self.b);J=np.vstack([jp[:,:7],jr[:,:7]])
   dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+np.eye(6)*.00005,e)
   dq*=min(1,.15/max(np.max(abs(dq)),1e-9));q[:7]=np.clip(q[:7]+dq,s.lower[:7]+.001,s.upper[:7]-.001)
  return q
 def move(self,p,R,h=None,n=120):
  p0,R0=self.pose();rv=Rot.from_matrix(R@R0.T).as_rotvec();h0=self.s.targets[7:].copy()
  if h is None:h=h0
  for i in range(n):
   a=(i+1)/n;a=a*a*(3-2*a)
   q=self.ik(p0+(p-p0)*a,Rot.from_rotvec(rv*a).as_matrix()@R0);q[7:]=h0+(h-h0)*a
   self.s.step(q)
 def hold(self,n=60):
  for i in range(n):self.s.step(self.s.targets)
 def snap(self,name):
  for c in ['front','side','oblique']:
   Image.fromarray(self.s.render(c)).resize((960,720)).save('/app/output/'+name+'_'+c+'.png')
 def contacts(self):
  for c in self.d.contact:
   n1=self.m.geom(c.geom1).name;n2=self.m.geom(c.geom2).name
   if 'object_' in n1 or 'object_' in n2:print(n1,n2,'dist',c.dist,'pos',c.pos)
Rdown=np.array([[0,1,0],[0,0,-1],[-1,0,0.]])
def hand(f=.7,t=(1.2,0,.4,0,.6)):
 h=np.zeros(22);h[:5]=t
 for i in [5,9,13,18]:h[i:i+4]=[f,0,f,.7*f]
 return h
